label: OLD-BENCHMARK exploratory/sensitivity analyses (64 constructed answers, 8 questions); none is confirmatory

cluster.primary_bootstrap: two-level: resample 8 questions with replacement, then resample the 8 answers of each drawn question with replacement
cluster.secondary_bootstrap: question-only: resample whole questions with replacement, keep all answers of a drawn question
cluster.interval: percentile 95% (2.5, 97.5); replicates with undefined statistic are dropped and counted

false_accept.tau_provenance: services/evaluator/app.py grade boundaries: Good >= 0.60, Excellent >= 0.75 (no explicit accept threshold exists; both reported, none chosen post hoc)
false_accept.definition: false accept = adversarial-set item with score >= tau; accept-rate on correct-reference set reported alongside
false_accept.threshold_free: AUROC (correct_reference vs adversarial) for every scorer, two-level cluster bootstrap CI, paired difference composite minus R_only from the same draws
false_accept.matched_operating_point: for each non-composite scorer, threshold = the largest observed score value whose accept-rate on the correct-reference set is >= the composite's accept-rate at the same tau; false-accept then read off (rule, recomputed inside each bootstrap replicate)

rater_leave_one_out.gold_r: mean of the two remaining raters' raw scores for all 64 items
rater_leave_one_out.note: the frozen gold uses adjudication for 10 items; LOO gold does not

pilot_overlap.report: point estimates only (n=32 each); no CI, no test; not a held-out validation

length_bias: Spearman(model - human, answer word count from the rater file candidate_answer)
run_rule: all analyses computed in one run; no iteration or re-running after inspection; output directory research/analysis/phase1/x2_a/
no_leakage: no parameter of X2-B or X2-C (tau, categories, rho_min, operating-point rule, sample size) is chosen from X2-A output
